project_identity.name: MINEPX — Autonomous Pixel Mining
project_identity.tagline: Server-Persistent Pixel Expeditions & Robinhood Chain GLD Pool Shares
project_identity.context: Interactive Gaming Dashboard & Pixel Mining Visualizer
project_identity.theme: Dark Steampunk/Industrial (Charcoal, Antique Brass, Luminous Gold)
project_identity.file_extension_notice: JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) ecosystem used across frontend.

design_principles.fusion: Combines retro 16-bit arcade pixel aesthetics with high-density industrial telemetry dashboards and Swiss precision typographic hierarchy.
design_principles.emotion: Tactile subterranean urgency, high-stakes exploration, raw metallic reward clarity without synthetic hype or fake APY counters.
design_principles.content_storytelling: Every pixel miner agent possesses an individual personality, status cycle, and rule-engine journal entry based on real server events.
anti_slop_rules: NO generic light themes or saturated tech-purple gradients (#7351B7 strictly forbidden).
NO fake 'Demo Mode' badges or synthetic simulated APY counters.
NO complete transparent backgrounds on headers, overlays, or floating menus.
NO 'Inter everywhere' for headings — use heavy industrial display typography like Barlow Condensed/Exo 2 paired with JetBrains Mono.
NO universal CSS transitions (e.g., transition: all). Only target explicit transform/opacity/color properties.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider
scale.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide
scale.journal_mono: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono tracking-tight text-amber-200/90 leading-tight

layout_and_navigation.structure: Fixed dark top header with glassmorphic blur, left/top tab bar for view switching, main viewport area with dynamic grid allocations.

routes.label: Shared Pixel Mine
routes.description: Public animated pixel cave visualizer running continuous autonomous worker cycles with bot crew and live server feed.

routes.label: My Agent
routes.description: Single-agent persistent creation & telemetry control panel with state machine, equipment repair, and rule-engine journal.

routes.label: Mining Pool & GLD
routes.description: Robinhood Chain GLD pool metrics, 24h cycle tracker, balance-time weight breakdown, and unverified contract fallback states.

routes.label: Field Guide
routes.description: Mine lore, ore catalog, exploration achievements, cosmetics unlocked by discovery, and autonomous agent rules.

layout_and_navigation.header_rules: Must include MINEPX logo, Robinhood Chain badge, GLD Pool summary, Wallet connect modal trigger, and active tab selector. Background must use bg-[#14161C]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#3A3125].

pixijs_mine_visualizer_guidelines.container: Aspect-ratio preserved responsive canvas canvas wrapped in charcoal-finished border frame.
sprite_elements: Basecamp & Tool Rack: Resting zone for miners undergoing repairs.
Surveying Nodes: Crystal seams & scanner beacons.
Mining Shafts: Active pickaxe animations & glowing ore veins.
Ore Carts & Rails: Hauling pathways to central refinery.
Refinery Furnace: Ember particle generator & gold ingot output queue.
pixijs_mine_visualizer_guidelines.rendering_behavior: Smooth 60 FPS update loop with pixel-snapping (PIXI.settings.ROUND_PIXELS = true). Crisp retro scale without blurry smoothing.

data_state_rules.finance_unverified: Display 'Not available' when wallet or smart contract pool metrics are unverified. NEVER show fake numbers, placeholder zero balances, or fake APY percentages.
data_state_rules.persistent_execution: Agents keep mining on backend worker process even when browser is closed or wallet disconnects.
data_state_rules.crew_identification: Crew bot agents must be explicitly badge-labeled as '[CREW BOT]' to prevent confusing them with wallet-owned agents.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: APCA high-contrast compliance for dark charcoal background with gold/brass text.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attribute_requirement: All interactive buttons, links, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and status panels MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user-facing strings are exclusively in English.
Do not put any 'demo' or 'placeholder' watermarks in UI text.
Ensure PixiJS visualizer canvas is initialized smoothly without throwing missing canvas context errors.
Provide clear feedback for unverified contracts ('Not available') without breaking UI structure.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
